name: Outlandish Games
bio: Outlandish Games is a small publisher of tabletop games about conflict, cooperation, power and resistance, founded in 2015 as Out of Order Games and renamed in 2023. Its flagship title, Bloc by Bloc by Greg Loring-Albright and T.L. Simons, is released under a Creative Commons BY-NC-SA 4.0 licence, including the complete print-and-play files for the third edition, Bloc by Bloc: Uprising.
